Data Source

Provenance of each building's coordinates & height.

  • Official (DPMPTSP)2556
  • Google V3 coord + 2.5D height2175
  • Google V3 coord + CTBUH height70

Jakarta uses the DPMPTSP official 3D registry (surveyed truth). Other cities use Google V3 footprints + 2.5D height estimates; a subset of landmark towers carry CTBUH-surveyed true heights. Building names & addresses are kept in the original Indonesian.

Indonesia High-Rise Landscape · Jakarta figures are official (DPMPTSP, ≥32m subset); other 11 cities are conservative lower-bound estimates from Google Open Buildings V3 + 2.5D and CTBUH landmarks. Category values for non-Jakarta cities are partly inferred from building names and may be marked Unclassified where no signal exists. Basemap tiles require an internet connection.
